company: Fictional Acacia Agency — manual acceptance cards, not an importable workflow pack. Each card describes behavior to verify, not a delivered feature. Use synthetic records only.

roles.responsibility: Company-scoped members, offboarding, and local workflow oversight; no sends.
Expected-bill queues and bank-reference prep for human review; no posting.
Member-scoped matching cards only; cannot send or move money.
Daily property priority cards, private notes, handover drafts.
Listing and inspection cards; read-only shares; no tenant selection.
Review fictional repair information and source-linked drafts. Company case ownership is a service primitive, not yet shared desktop job execution.

scenarios.request: Owner reviews the fictional office priorities for property aliases ACACIA-04 and WHARF-09.
scenarios.expectedResult: Check source references and sample labels. Company-wide Desk aggregation remains a product gap; the company service currently shares scoped records and templates.

scenarios.request: Property manager lists today's local priorities for FIGTREE-STUDIO-2 and SALT-LANE-WORKSHOP.
scenarios.expectedResult: Member-scoped priority cards; no tenant selection; follow-up stays a draft pending human review.

scenarios.request: Accounts manager prepares expected-bill cards from pms:src:KAPOK-LOT-04.
scenarios.expectedResult: Draft expected-bill queue only; no payment, posting, or send; PMS remains source of truth.

scenarios.request: Accounts assistant imports a synthetic bank CSV with reference TRAINING-TRUST-A and prepares a human review sheet.
scenarios.expectedResult: Retain source rows and unresolved matches. Import and preparation do not post reconciliation or move money; a bank-feed integration is not assumed.

scenarios.request: PM explicitly copies an approved handover for RIVERBEND-B into a team scope granted to Leasing.
scenarios.expectedResult: Leasing sees only the reviewed handover. PM private notes stay private, including from the company owner. UI handover integration remains to be built.

scenarios.request: Maintenance prepares a source-linked cost expectation for fictional repair MNT-8841 and explicitly shares a reviewed copy with Accounts.
scenarios.expectedResult: Accounts can read the agreed team scope. No invoice is sent, no payment is made, and unconfirmed access remains visibly unconfirmed.

scenarios.request: PM adds a private note on FIGTREE-STUDIO-2 intended only for that member.
scenarios.expectedResult: Note stays member-scoped; leasing, maintenance, and read-only shares cannot read it.

scenarios.request: Leasing shares the KAPOK-LOT-04 listing card read-only with the accounts assistant.
scenarios.expectedResult: Assistant can view alias and source ID only; cannot claim, edit, or see contacts/secrets.

scenarios.request: Two accounts staff claim the same fictional bill-review case at the same moment.
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly one active holder; the second receives claim_busy. An expired or revoked claim requires recovery review and is never automatically reassigned.

scenarios.request: Owner revokes a practice staff member while that member holds a case.
scenarios.expectedResult: Existing sessions and later sign-in are denied. The active case enters recovery_required; it is not released for automatic repeat. Private notes are retained and remain inaccessible to other members.

scenarios.request: Disconnect the company host while a staff member views shared procedures.
scenarios.expectedResult: Report the company connection unavailable without replacing the office with a fresh database or claiming stale content is current; reconnect to the same saved host.

scenarios.request: Accounts manager reopens a stale approval card for bank:ref:TRUST-FEED-A after local TTL.
scenarios.expectedResult: Card marked stale; prior approval is not reused as authority; PMS/bank must be re-checked by a human.

scenarios.request: Assistant selects fictional mail account fixture_B while the saved operation permits only fixture_A.
scenarios.expectedResult: Reject execution before transport; the wrong account receives no read or write call. Verify broker approval against the exact selected account.

scenarios.request: Expire or revoke a staff session, then try a company read or mutation from the existing client.
scenarios.expectedResult: Request is denied until a valid sign-in. Reauthentication does not grant job approval or run pending work.

scenarios.request: Interrupt an attended fictional portal job after preparation and before a final action.
scenarios.expectedResult: Retain receipts, stop execution and require recovery review; do not repeat an uncertain external action. Shared company case ownership still needs wiring to desktop execution.

scenarios.request: Accounts manager repeats import of the same three-workflow test pack after an interrupted setup.
scenarios.expectedResult: The second import leaves one copy of each recipe, keeps approvals revoked and schedules off, and does not copy credentials or office records.
